rules.label: Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) of at least 6 semesters in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a closely related subject

check.note: The University of Stuttgart's Board of Admission decides whether your degree is equivalent and closely related enough; the 6-semester duration is not a profile fact.

citations.quote: General requirement is a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with a duration of at least 6 semesters in Computer Science, Software Engineering or in a subject closely related.

rules.label: English at level C1: TOEFL iBT 95, IELTS Academic 7.0, Cambridge CAE/CPE, Oxford Test Advanced, PTE Academic 76, telc, or citizenship and education in a native-English country

children.note: The exception needs citizenship AND education in a listed country (Canada except Quebec); the level and length of education are not specified, so the Admission Committee decides. A proof of citizenship (passport copy) is uploaded instead of a test.

citations.quote: TOEFL IBT 95 points / from 2026: 5 or better
Cambridge ESOL CAE/CPE University of Cambridge ESOL exams
telc: telc University B2/C1 (result „very good“); telc C1 / C2 (general examination)
“Medium of Instruction (MOI)”, e.g. certificate confirming your bachelor’s program was conducted in English, is not accepted.
If you are a national with citizenship and education in one of the countries listed below, you do not need to upload one of the English proficiency proofs listed above.

rules.label: The English certificate must be valid until the application deadline (most certificates expire after two years)

check.note: The two-year validity and the application deadline are not modelled (no date check); you must check your certificate's expiry yourself.

citations.quote: The uploaded certificate has to be valid at least until the application deadline (15th of January/July).

rules.label: The Board of Admission decides whether the conditions are fulfilled, and may require an interview, an entrance examination or conditions

check.note: The Board of Admission decides from your documents; if conditions are not fulfilled an interview or entrance examination may be needed, and missing qualifications may be made up during the studies. Nothing here is computed.

citations.quote: On the basis of the documents presented, the Board of Admission (Zulassungsausschuss) decides whether the conditions of entry are fulfilled or not.
In case of the latter, an interview or an entrance examination may be necessary.
